item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena prepares a rose petal extract at home to test some substances.

The extract turns pink in lemon juice and green in soap solution.

She adds the extract to a sample of an unknown colourless liquid, and it turns pink.

What is the nature of the unknown liquid?

options.A: acidic, because it gives the same colour as lemon juice
options.B: basic, because it gives a different colour from soap solution
options.C: neutral, because the liquid itself is colourless
options.D: basic, because rose extract is a natural substance
